description: NOT a planted defect -- a MEASURED, PREDICTED-IN-ADVANCE TOOL FINDING (docs/specs/audit-known-good.md sec 5.1 predicted, before this file was built, that i8 cannot pass ANY well-formed support file under the current liveness-role model, because a validly-seated TIP is its own ground and nothing in roles R1-R4 can ever mark a plain TAPER/MEMBER/FLARE beneath it as live).
